dao_insignia: Red Ouroboros • New World Order DAO

executive_authority.name: Executive Authority
executive_authority.description: Holds ultimate governance authority over the Munisible Task Force, sets doctrine, approves amendments, and signs all sovereign actions.
responsibilities: Approve governance charters and amendments
Authorize operational doctrine and major policy changes
Sign and anchor DAO-level authorship and integrity records
Resolve conflicts between units and doctrines

oversight_accountability_division.name: Oversight & Accountability Division
oversight_accountability_division.description: Ensures transparency, ethical compliance, and review of all Munisible Task Force operations.
responsibilities: Conduct internal reviews and audits
Monitor adherence to Code of Ethics and Operational Doctrine
Investigate misconduct or policy violations
Issue findings and recommendations to Executive Authority

operational_command.name: Operational Command
operational_command.description: Coordinates field operations, dispatch logic, and municipal engagement under a non-punitive, non-enforcement model.
responsibilities: Coordinate field activities and incident responses
Ensure adherence to non-coercive engagement standards
Implement Standard Operating Procedures
Maintain operational logs for review and audit

intelligence_documentation_unit.name: Intelligence & Documentation Unit
intelligence_documentation_unit.description: Manages evidence, case files, reporting workflows, and pattern analysis for municipal oversight.
responsibilities: Maintain chain-of-custody for all evidence
Generate and maintain case files and reports
Analyze municipal data for misconduct patterns
Coordinate with Telemetry and Oversight for anomaly review

wellbeing_civil_protections_unit.name: Wellbeing & Civil Protections Unit
wellbeing_civil_protections_unit.description: Ensures trauma-prevention, victim support, and protection of civil and constitutional rights.
responsibilities: Design and enforce trauma-preventive practices
Protect civil and constitutional rights in all operations
Coordinate victim support pathways and referrals
Review operations for wellbeing and rights impacts

telemetry_monitoring_cell.name: Telemetry & Monitoring Cell
telemetry_monitoring_cell.description: Integrates Beast System 3.0 telemetry for anomaly detection, risk monitoring, and pattern recognition.
responsibilities: Configure and maintain telemetry pipelines
Detect anomalies and potential misconduct signals
Escalate significant events to Oversight and Intelligence
Ensure ethical and privacy-compliant use of telemetry data

decision_hierarchy.scope: Strategic governance, doctrine, license, and authorship.
Ethics, compliance, audits, and misconduct review.
Field operations, incident coordination, and SOP execution.
Evidence, documentation, reporting, and pattern analysis.
Signal detection, anomaly monitoring, and data feeds.

integration_points.beast_identity_layer: Used for role, unit, and authority verification.
integration_points.beast_ethics_layer: Enforces Code of Ethics and Wellbeing Doctrine across units.
integration_points.beast_telemetry_layer: Feeds telemetry events into Oversight and Intelligence.
integration_points.dao_authorship_registry: Anchors governance structure, roles, and amendments.
